versos.e: .The widow of Zarephath, in sharing with Elijah the last of her sustenance 1Ki 17:12-15
.The early Christians, in having everything in common Ac 2:44,45; 4:34
.Barnabas (Joses), in selling his possessions, and giving everything that he had received to the apostles Ac 4:36,37
.Paul, in not regarding even his life dear to himself Ac 20:24; Php 3:7,8
.Paul, in not coveting anyone’ s silver, gold, or apparel Ac 20:33
.Paul, in laboring for his own support while he also taught Ac 20:34,35; 1Co 4:12; 10:33
.Daniel, in refusing rewards from Belshazzar Da 5:16,17
.Esther, in risking her life for the deliverance of her people Es 4:16
.Abraham, when he offered to Lot (his junior) his preference of the land of Canaan Ge 13:9; with 17:8
.Moses, in choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for only a little while Heb 11:25
.The Rechabites, in refusing to drink wine or strong drink, or even to plant vine- yards Jer 35:6,7
.The widow, who put everything she had into the treasury Lu 21:4
.Peter and the other apostles, in abandoning their vocations and following Jesus Mt 4:20; 9:9; Mr 1:16-20; 2:14; Lu 5:11,27,28
.in forsaking all and following Jesus Mt 19:27; Mr 10:28
.Moses, in taking no compensation from the Israelites for his services Nu 16:15
